## POST /v1/pdf/forms/fields

Lists a PDF's form fields with their kinds, pages and values.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | files | Yes | Two PDFs: the base, then the overlay laid over it page by page. |
| `outputFilename` | string | No |  |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The form fields | array of FieldSchema |
| 400 | The request is wrong | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | Not supported in this version | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## POST /v1/pdf/forms/fill

Fills a PDF form from data, applying tags in annotations, optionally
flattening the result.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | file | Yes | The PDF with form fields, and optionally tags in annotations. |
| `ctx` | JSON | No |  |
| `data` | JSON | No | JSON object, sent as text or as a file; a field named `customer.name` takes that path. |
| `flatten` | boolean | No | Fix the values into the page content. |
| `outputFilename` | string | No |  |
| `stripAnnotations` | boolean | No | Remove the annotations that carried tags. Default true. |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The filled PDF | File |
| 204 | Accepted; the result goes to the webhook |  |
| 400 | The request is wrong | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 422 | The template failed to render | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | Not supported in this version | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |

## POST /v1/pdf/overlay

Lays the second PDF over the first, page by page.

Needs credentials, if any are configured.

### Request

`multipart/form-data`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | files | Yes | Two PDFs: the base, then the overlay laid over it page by page. |
| `outputFilename` | string | No |  |

### Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The combined PDF | File |
| 204 | Accepted; the result goes to the webhook |  |
| 400 | The request is wrong | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
| 501 | Not supported in this version | [`ErrorBody`](/docs/reference/api/schemas/#errorbody) |
